[Intro: stomp and clap beat, twanging guitar riff, hold tone]

[Verse 1: low dry male baritone]

Someone will be with you soon
We know what you need

Press two if you're scared
Press three for forgiveness
Press nine if you've prayed

[Chorus: full stomp, voices answering]
Your call is important (to us)
Please stay on the line
Your call is important (to us)
You are number nine
Somebody will hear you
Somebody will care
Your call is important
Is anybody there?

[Bridge: beat drops to breath and stomp, whispered]
Hold. Hold. Hold. Hold.

[Guitar Break: slide guitar over the stomp]

[Final Chorus: full stomp, voices answering]
Your call is important (to us)
Please stay on the line
Your call is important (to us)
You are number one
Somebody will hear you
Somebody is here
